stem: Alicia has not provided a thesis for her paper. Which of the following should come after sentence 4 to serve as a thesis statement for this paper?

options.label: A
options.text: In other words, the facial expressions and body postures you adopt can actually influence how you feel.

options.label: B
options.text: However, you’ve probably already heard that people assess what you’re feeling by observing your body language.

options.label: C
options.text: Interestingly, the entire concept seems to have been proved to work in reverse as well.

options.label: D
options.text: For example, your basic feelings can be attributed to how people perceive you to be holding your body.
